feature1.prompt: Inconsistent behavior of world_to_pixel in SlicedLowLevelWCS. The issue occurs when converting world coordinates to pixel values in a 3D WCS when a 2D slice corresponding to a single wavelength is taken. In the full (unsliced) WCS the world_to_pixel operation returns the expected central pixel in space and first pixel in wavelength. However, when a single wavelength slice is used, the first pixel coordinate becomes essentially infinite. This behavior is demonstrated using code examples that perform world_to_pixel and pixel_to_world operations on both the full and sliced WCS, showing the discrepancy in the first spatial coordinate between the unsliced and sliced cases.
